issues.quote: I could see at once that he had not suffered for long. Death would have been very quick.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about how long Monnier lived after the blow or when he died.
issues.misreading: A solver could read this as a duration: that death came quickly after the blow, which narrows when the attack happened relative to the clock readings. The sheet gives no such timing.

issues.quote: DR VAUTHIER: Stopped. I looked at it, I confess, because I could not look at him for long.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the wall regulator. It gives no reading for it.
issues.misreading: A solver could take the stopped regulator as a time reading, or assume it stopped at a particular moment. Nothing in the sheet supports either reading.
